sessions.label: Panel 2 · Thematic Discussion Panel
sessions.description: Without a terminology service governing the codes that flow through an HIE, semantic drift is inevitable. Panelists explain the upstream/downstream model: validating and normalising codes at ingestion, then mapping between standards to reuse stored codes for immunisation registries, population health phenotyping and other use cases.
